The stored numbers come from Galileo's 2025 product manual (maker PDF) and are LOWER/lighter than the current page (C1 660x320x470 mm /15 kg vs 765x410x475 mm /22 kg; E1 1000x420x600 mm /38 kg vs 1000x452x550 mm /52 kg; S1 1100x450x700 mm /60 kg vs 1200x550x650 mm /118 kg), i.e. the page appears to describe the 2026 line-up.
